provenance.expected_basis: DbInteger, DbText, DbBoolean, DbFloating, DbDecimal and DbBytes (#188, in place of Param) preserve the exact scalar category; their Maybe.none binds SQL NULL. SQL-looking strings stay data, and the same DbValue protocol is accepted by Statement and prepared statements.
